name: Android TV and Google TV
note: Televisions are not phones. There is no dialer, no SMS app and no payment app, and the home screen is a leanback launcher that most sets will not let you replace without a fight. The large wins here are the recommendation engine that fills the home screen with sponsored rows, the always-listening assistant, and the screensaver that downloads images continuously. Everything in this file was written for televisions; the phone lists do not apply and are not loaded for a TV.

packages.label: TV Recommendations
packages.note: The service that fills the home screen with rows you did not ask for, including sponsored ones. The single biggest improvement on most sets.

packages.label: Backdrop / Ambient screensaver
packages.note: Downloads artwork continuously whenever the TV idles, and on some sets shows promoted content. Your own screensaver still works.

packages.label: Google Search and Assistant for TV
packages.note: Voice search from the remote stops working. On some sets the microphone button then does nothing at all rather than falling back.

packages.label: TV Setup Wizard
packages.note: Only runs during first-time setup and after a factory reset.

packages.label: Chromecast built-in
packages.note: Casting to this TV from a phone stops working. Keep it if anyone in the house casts.

packages.label: Text-to-Speech
packages.note: Spoken feedback and accessibility narration stop. Leave it on any TV someone uses by ear.

packages.label: TV Provider (channel database)
packages.note: Holds the channel and programme database. Live TV and every recommendation row break without it.

packages.label: Google TV Home
packages.note: The home screen on newer Google TV sets. Install and set a replacement leanback launcher first, or the TV boots to nothing.

packages.label: Android TV Home (leanback)
packages.note: The home screen on older Android TV sets. Same warning: replacement first.

packages.label: Framework package stubs
packages.note: Catches intents a TV has no app for, such as opening a file. Disabling it turns a harmless 'no app found' into a crash in some apps.

packages.label: Netflix (TV preload)
packages.note: The TV build of Netflix. Often cannot be reinstalled from the Play Store on the same set, so re-enable rather than uninstall.

packages.label: OnePlus TV Speaker service
packages.note: Drives the soundbar on sets that have one. Silence is a strong signal you should not have disabled it.

packages.label: OnePlus TV Remote service
packages.note: The remote stops responding. You would need ADB to undo it, which is a bad afternoon.

packages.label: Skyworth Updater
packages.note: Firmware updates stop arriving. Skyworth builds OnePlus televisions, so this appears on those too.

packages.label: PatchWall
packages.note: Xiaomi's ad-heavy alternative home screen. It is also a launcher, so replace it before disabling it.

packages.label: Sony Promotion Video Player
packages.note: Shop-demo loop left on retail sets.
